summary: The signed 32-bit input contract fixes the integer width, while the protected source performs one comparison and one remainder operation for every value.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source-fidelity-verified constraint bounds n to the signed 32-bit interval from -2^31 through 2^31 - 1.

replacement_checks.evidence: The source checks positivity and evaluates 1,162,261,467 modulo n. Under the fixed-width contract, this is a constant number of constant-width operations, proving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

An independent repeated-division oracle agrees with the app-local predicate over -100,000 through 100,000, every in-range power of three and its immediate neighbors, and both signed 32-bit boundaries.
